title: Chemical optimization of the exercise mimetic SLU-PP-332 enables insight into estrogen-related receptor signaling.
authors: Okda, Hazem Essam; Zhao, Puhan; Hayes, Matt; Duvall, Colten; Quillin, Elsa; Fang, Hong; Mohammed, Bassem M; Hegazy, Lamees; Burris, Thomas P; Elgendy, Bahaa
one_liner_zh: 该文研究ERR受体激动剂SLU-PP-332的化学优化与SAR，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为核受体-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Estrogen-related receptors (ERRs) are master regulators of mitochondrial metabolism and exercise-responsive transcription, yet only a limited number of synthetic agonists with suitable potency and drug-like properties have been reported. SLU-PP-332 is a well-established exercise mimetic and widely used chemical probe for ERR activation; however, the structural features governing its potency, efficacy, selectivity, and drug-like properties have not been systematically elucidated. Here, we report the first comprehensive structure-activity relationship (SAR) analysis of the SLU-PP-332 scaffold, integrating chemical synthesis, cell-based functional assays, downstream gene-expression profiling, and computational modeling. Through iterative modification of core pharmacophoric elements, we identify key structural determinants that control ERRalpha and ERRgamma agonism, transcriptional efficacy, ligand efficiency, and physicochemical properties. While SLU-PP-332 remains a strong benchmark for ERR activation, several analogues achieve comparable or context-dependent transcriptional responses while exhibiting improved ligand efficiency, solubility, or metabolic stability. Computational docking and molecular dynamics simulations reveal how subtle structural modifications influence ERR engagement and signaling outcomes. Together, this work defines design principles for tuning ERR agonism and provides a foundational SAR roadmap for the rational development of next-generation ERR agonists and exercise-mimetic therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 雌激素相关受体（ERRs）是线粒体代谢和运动响应性转录的主要调控因子，然而目前仅有少数具有适当效力和类药性质的合成激动剂被报道。SLU-PP-332是一种公认的运动模拟物，并被广泛用作ERR激活的化学探针；然而，控制其效力、效能、选择性和类药性质的结构特征尚未被系统阐明。在此，我们报告了SLU-PP-332骨架的首次全面构效关系（SAR）分析，整合了化学合成、基于细胞的功能测定、下游基因表达谱分析和计算建模。通过对核心药效团元素的迭代修饰，我们识别出控制ERRalpha和ERRgamma激动作用、转录效能、配体效率和理化性质的关键结构决定因素。尽管SLU-PP-332仍是ERR激活的强基准，但若干类似物在表现出改善的配体效率、溶解度或代谢稳定性的同时，实现了相当或情境依赖性的转录响应。计算对接和分子动力学模拟揭示了细微的结构修饰如何影响ERR结合和信号传导结果。综合来看，本研究定义了调节ERR激动作用的设计原则，并为下一代ERR激动剂和运动模拟疗法的合理开发提供了基础性SAR路线图。
